with task_scope as ( select id, project_id, model_invocation_id from test_design_task where id = cast(#{taskId} as uuid) ), candidates as ( select id, requirement_id, model_invocation_id, asset_case_id from test_design_candidate where task_id = cast(#{taskId} as uuid) ), publish_records as ( select asset_case_id from test_design_publish_record where task_id = cast(#{taskId} as uuid) and dry_run = false and asset_case_id is not null ), invocation_ids as ( select model_invocation_id from task_scope where model_invocation_id is not null union select model_invocation_id from candidates where model_invocation_id is not null ), audit_events as ( select action, resource_type, result from audit_log where ( resource_type = 'TEST_DESIGN_TASK' and resource_id = cast(#{taskId} as text) ) or ( resource_type in ('TEST_DESIGN_CANDIDATE', 'TEST_DESIGN_REVIEW_RECORD', 'TEST_DESIGN_TASK_REPORT') and after_json ->> 'taskId' = cast(#{taskId} as text) ) ), wp2_invocations as ( select status, fallback_used, input_tokens, output_tokens, latency_ms, total_cost from ma_invocation_log where id in (select model_invocation_id from invocation_ids) ), wp2_jobs as ( select job_id, trace_id from ma_invocation_job where invocation_id in (select model_invocation_id from invocation_ids) ), published_cases as ( select distinct atc.id from asset_test_case atc join publish_records pr on pr.asset_case_id = atc.id join task_scope ts on ts.project_id = atc.project_id where atc.deleted_at is null and atc.source = 'AI_GENERATED' ), trace_links as ( select distinct l.source_id, l.target_id from asset_link l join candidates c on c.requirement_id = l.source_id join published_cases pc on pc.id = l.target_id where l.deleted_at is null and l.source_type = 'REQUIREMENT' and l.target_type = 'CASE' ), task_related_resource_ids as ( select cast(id as text) as resource_id from task_scope union select cast(id as text) as resource_id from candidates union select cast(asset_case_id as text) as resource_id from publish_records where asset_case_id is not null ), outbox_events as ( select status from audit_outbox o where coalesce( o.event_payload_json ->> 'resourceId', o.event_payload_json ->> 'resource_id', o.event_payload_json ->> 'aggregateId', o.event_payload_json #>> '{record,resourceId}', o.event_payload_json #>> '{record,resource_id}', o.event_payload_json #>> '{payload,resourceId}', o.event_payload_json #>> '{payload,resource_id}', '' ) in (select resource_id from task_related_resource_ids) or coalesce( o.event_payload_json ->> 'taskId', o.event_payload_json ->> 'task_id', o.event_payload_json #>> '{record,taskId}', o.event_payload_json #>> '{record,task_id}', o.event_payload_json #>> '{metadata,taskId}', o.event_payload_json #>> '{metadata,task_id}', o.event_payload_json #>> '{payload,taskId}', o.event_payload_json #>> '{payload,task_id}', '' ) = cast(#{taskId} as text) ) select coalesce((select count(*) from audit_events), 0) as wp1_audit_event_count, coalesce((select count(*) from audit_events where result = 'SUCCESS'), 0) as wp1_audit_success_count, coalesce((select count(*) from audit_events where result = 'FAILED'), 0) as wp1_audit_failure_count, coalesce((select count(*) from audit_events where result = 'DENIED'), 0) as wp1_audit_denied_count, coalesce((select count(*) from audit_events where resource_type = 'TEST_DESIGN_TASK'), 0) as wp1_task_audit_event_count, coalesce((select count(*) from audit_events where resource_type = 'TEST_DESIGN_CANDIDATE'), 0) as wp1_candidate_export_audit_event_count, coalesce((select count(*) from audit_events where resource_type = 'TEST_DESIGN_REVIEW_RECORD'), 0) as wp1_review_export_audit_event_count, coalesce((select count(*) from audit_events where resource_type = 'TEST_DESIGN_TASK_REPORT'), 0) as wp1_report_export_audit_event_count, coalesce((select count(*) from wp2_invocations), 0) as wp2_invocation_count, coalesce((select count(*) from wp2_invocations where status = 'SUCCEEDED'), 0) as wp2_invocation_succeeded_count, coalesce((select count(*) from wp2_invocations where status = 'FAILED'), 0) as wp2_invocation_failed_count, coalesce((select count(*) from wp2_invocations where status = 'BLOCKED'), 0) as wp2_invocation_blocked_count, coalesce((select count(*) from wp2_invocations where fallback_used = true), 0) as wp2_fallback_count, coalesce((select sum(input_tokens) from wp2_invocations), 0) as wp2_input_token_total, coalesce((select sum(output_tokens) from wp2_invocations), 0) as wp2_output_token_total, coalesce((select sum(latency_ms) from wp2_invocations), 0) as wp2_latency_ms_total, coalesce((select sum(total_cost)::text from wp2_invocations), '0') as wp2_total_cost_text, coalesce((select count(*) from wp2_jobs), 0) as wp2_job_count, coalesce((select count(*) from wp2_jobs where trace_id is not null and trace_id <> ''), 0) as wp2_trace_signal_count, coalesce((select count(*) from published_cases), 0) as wp3_published_case_count, coalesce((select count(*) from trace_links), 0) as wp3_trace_link_count, coalesce((select count(*) from outbox_events where status = 'PENDING'), 0) as audit_outbox_pending_count, coalesce((select count(*) from outbox_events where status = 'FAILED'), 0) as audit_outbox_failed_count, coalesce((select count(*) from outbox_events where status = 'DEAD'), 0) as audit_outbox_dead_count
